chunks.arabic_text: غَيْبَةُ الطَّابِسِيِّ: بِإِسْنَادِهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْحِميريِّ قَالَ

translations.en: Ghayba of al-Tabari (al-Tusi): Via his chain to Abdallah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari who said:

chunks.arabic_text: كَتَبَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الْعَسْكَرِيُّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ إِلَى عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْقَزْوِينِيِّ بِخَطِّهِ: اعْتَقِدْ فِيمَا تَدِينُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى بِهِ أَنَّ الْبَاطِنَ عِنْدِي حَسَبَ مَا أَظْهَرْتُ لَكَ فِي مَنْ اسْتَنْبَأْتَ عَنْهُ، وَهُوَ فَارِسٌ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَسْعُكَ إِلَّا الِاجْتِهَادُ فِي لَعْنِهِ، وَقَصْدِهِ وَمُعَادَاتِهِ، وَالْمُبَالَغَةُ فِي ذَلِكَ بِأَكْثَرِ مَا تَجِدُ السَّبِيلَ إِلَيْهِ. مَا كُنْتُ آمُرُ أَنْ يُدَانَ اللَّهُ بِأَمْرٍ غَيْرِ صَحِيحٍ، فَجِدْ وَشُدْ فِي لَعْنِهِ وَهَتْكِهِ، وَقَطْعِ أَسْبَابِهِ، وَصَدِّ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْهُ، وَإِبْطَالِ أَمْرِهِ وَأَبْلِغْهُمْ ذَلِكَ مِنِّي، وَاحْكُ لَهُمْ عَنِّي، وَإِنِّي سَائِلُكُمْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ اللَّهِ عَنْ هَذَا الْأَمْرِ الْمُؤَكَّدِ، فَوَيْلٌ لِلْعَاصِي وَلِلْ جَاحِدِ. وَكَتَبْتُ بِخَطِّي لَيْلَةَ الثَّلَاثَاءِ لِتِسْعِ لَيَالٍ مَضَيْنَ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَبِيعٍ الْأَوَّلِ سَنَةَ خَمْسِينَ وَمِائَتَيْنِ، وَأَنَا أَتَوَكَّلُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَأَحْمَدُهُ كَثِيرًا

translations.en: Abu al-Hasan al-Askari (peace be upon him) wrote to Ali ibn Amr al-Qazwini in his own hand: Believe, as part of your religion through which you worship Allah the Exalted, that my inner feelings for the one you questioned about, that is Faris, may Allah curse him, are identical to that which I have manifested to you. For nothing else behooves you apart from striving hard in cursing him, targeting him and treating him as an enemy. Intensify doing that as far as is possible for you to do. I could never order that Allah be worshipped through something which is not correct. So strain yourself and show firmness in cursing him, exposing him, disrupting his means, blocking our companions from him and nullifying his schemes. Convey this to them and source it on my authority. I will surely ask you in front of Allah about this issue. So woe be upon the disobedient and the opposer. I have written [this letter] in my own hand, being Tuesday night, nine nights having passed from the start of the month of Rabi al-Awwal, in the year two hundred and fifty. I depend on Allah and praise Him profusely.

en.summary: This letter from Imam al-Hadi (AS) to Ali ibn Amr al-Qazwini clarifies the status of Faris ibn Hatim, confirming that the Imam's outward stance was genuine and not merely Taqiyya, thereby commanding vigorous opposition and cursing. It underscores the principle of 'Al-Wala' wa al-Bara' (loyalty and disavowal) in Shia theology, where active enmity towards specific enemies is a religious duty. The Imam emphasizes that this specific command was correct and binding, warning against those who might deny or downplay this stance.
en.seo_question: What did Imam al-Hadi say about his true feelings towards Faris ibn Hatim in his letter to Ali ibn Amr?
